current_evidence: Searches return this article (and the householder article 9630) as Preston's validation checklist pages and no newer separate list was found, but the www page could not be fetched; the non-www copy (preston.gov.uk/article/5129/...) reads 'adopted March 2022' while a consultation on a revised draft closed 16 August 2024, so the adoption date could not be confirmed.

issues.detail: A National Highways NSIP guidance page was read as a Preston source. Its text fills the Full-planning rows 'Construction (Environmental) Management Plan' ('The Promoter must agree a Construction Traffic Management Plan (CTMP) with National Highways') and 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' ('National Highways' Net Zero Highways Strategy'), plus a tab item 'Annex A - How promoters should evidence the key requirements'. None of these are Preston validation requirements.

Grokbot mixed versions. Alongside the web page it dated October 2024, it took triggers from a separate PDF named '2022_FINAL_Validation_Checklist_-_Main_document.pdf' (2022 checklist). The Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Transport Assessment, Ecological Survey, HRA, Agricultural dwelling, Pre-application and Employment rows are all sourced from that PDF, so their triggers may reflect the superseded list.

Design and Access Statement is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval', 'Variation of condition s73' and 'Minerals & waste (county)', using text that says a DAS is NOT required for s73 applications, material changes of use or waste development. The meaning is inverted.
issues.evidence: 'Design and Access Statements are not required for the following: a) ...Section 73... c) A material change of use... d) Development which is waste development'

issues.detail: Block plan is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval' using text about an exemption for change-of-use planning applications with no external works. The checklist does not cover prior approval applications.
issues.evidence: 'Required for all applications, with the exception of change of use proposal where no external works are proposed.'

issues.detail: About 38 rows are tagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', but many apply to outline and reserved matters too. Examples: the Energy Efficiency Statement explicitly covers outline residential; Affordable Housing, SCI, Transport Assessment and FRA apply regardless of type. Heritage Statement and Structural Survey are placed only under Householder/LBC, although they apply to full applications (conservation area works, setting of listed buildings, barn conversions).
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement: works affecting listed buildings, conservation areas, their settings, historic parks/gardens, archaeology, non-designated heritage assets; Structural Survey: 'rebuilding or re-use of buildings, such as barn conversions'.

issues.detail: Employment Skills Statement is missing. It is required for commercial floorspace of 1,000 sqm or more (including cumulative floorspace) or housing of 30+ units. Grokbot's 'Employment / Economic Statement' row quotes only a document title, and the tab item 'Work trials and interview guarantees...' is an unlabelled fragment of this section.
issues.evidence: 'Employment Skills Statement' - 'commercial floorspace of 1,000 square metres or over'.

issues.detail: Energy Efficiency Statement is missing. It is required for all full residential applications, full non-residential of 500 sqm or more, and outline residential with enough detail (otherwise a letter of intent). Grokbot's Energy row uses National Highways text instead.
issues.evidence: 'Energy Efficiency Statement' heading (references Written Ministerial Statement 'published 25 March 2015').

issues.detail: Land Quality Assessment (contaminated land) is missing. Triggers: known or suspected contamination; previously developed land; sites within 250m of a current or former landfill; particularly vulnerable uses (allotments, residential, schools, hospitals).
Odour Assessment is missing. It is required for new odour sources that could harm amenity, or odour-sensitive development near an existing odour source.
Student Accommodation Assessment is missing. It is required for new or converted student accommodation outside the Local Plan Policy HS6 area.

'Replacement Dwellings and Extensions to Existing Dwellings in the Open Countryside' (with volume calculations) is missing. It applies in the open countryside, areas of separation and the AONB, and is relevant to householder extensions as well as full applications.
issues.evidence: 'Replacement Dwellings and Extensions to Existing Dwellings in the Open Countryside' heading.

issues.detail: Sustainable Drainage Pro-forma (all major development) is listed separately from the Sustainable Drainage Strategy but is not captured. The Outline-specific requirement (state approximate layout locations, scale parameters and access points where those matters are reserved) is also missing: Grokbot filed that text under 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)'.
issues.evidence: 'Sustainable Drainage Pro-forma: all major development'; 'Outline applications' section.

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are not triggers or are garbled. Floor plans/Elevations (Full) quotes telecoms text; the source trigger is new built development, new floorspace or change of use. Biodiversity Checklist (Full): 'Hence, there may be some cases where...'. Employment/Economic: 'Central Lancashire Employment Land Study - Update February 2022.' Pre-application advice quotes S106 heads-of-terms text. Photographs: 'The survey should include photographs as appropriate.' Noise and Travel Plan describe content only; the Travel Plan source trigger is all major development and development generating significant transport movements. Marketing quotes only the exclusion; the trigger is residential proposals on employment sites. Tall Building is prefixed 'Flood Hub'. DAS is prefixed 'Understanding biodiversity net gain - GOV.UK (' and cut off. HRA is a list fragment.

The Outline 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' row quotes 'Outline application primarily seek to establish the principle of a development', which has nothing to do with the flood sequential test. The Agricultural dwelling, FRA and Retail excerpts are cut off mid-sentence.
issues.evidence: Outline row trigger: 'undertaking the sequential test, including sharing any relevant information. 12 Outline applications Outline application primarily seek...'

issues.detail: Many tab_items are process text, links, fees or fragments: 'You can download a copy of the Validation Checklist...'; the paper-copy rule; 'Or you can download Fees for Planning Applications in England 1 April 2026'; 'Failure to provide... administrative charge of 10% (capped at £1,000)' and 'The charge seeks to recover...'; 'Further information and a blank version of template H...'; 'Work trials and interview guarantees...' (list fragment); 'The City Council recognises that different types of applications...'; 'Site Specific Flood Risk Assessment checklist must include:'; 'Major development advice - Preston City Council Minor development advice...' (navigation text); 'Ribble and Alt Estuaries...' (fragment); redaction/personal data notes.
issues.evidence: tab_items under 'Submission rules', 'Local forms / checklists', 'Drawing / document standards', 'Policy-driven requirements'.

issues.detail: Items are duplicated across the web page and the 2022 PDF: standard application form (three entries), 'Failure to provide the required information' (twice), viability redaction note (twice), tree/hedge annotation on site plan (twice), and repeated scale lines (1:50 or 1:100 twice).
issues.evidence: tab_items with identical text from article/5129 and 2022_FINAL_Validation_Checklist PDF.

summary: Grokbot's link is Preston's official checklist page but was blocked to fetch here, and its 'October 2024' date could not be verified: a copy of the page says 'adopted March 2022' and a revision was consulted on in summer 2024. Grokbot mixed in a 2022 PDF and an unrelated National Highways page, inverted the DAS exemptions into requirements for s73, change-of-use and waste rows, and missed local items including the Employment Skills Statement, Energy Efficiency Statement, Land Quality Assessment, Odour, Student Accommodation and the open-countryside replacement dwelling requirements. These findings were checked against the March 2022 copy of the page.

withdrawn_issues.detail: Could not confirm 'adopted October 2024'. The www page and both PDFs returned client errors. The copy of the same article served at preston.gov.uk (no www) says 'adopted March 2022' and has no 2024 or October text. The council consulted on a revised draft with comments due by 16 August 2024, so an October 2024 adoption is plausible but unverified. That copy may be stale, which is why it lacks BNG, Noise and Mineral Resource headings that Grokbot found.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: preston.gov.uk/article/5129: 'The Validation Checklist for planning and other applications was adopted March 2022.' Consultation page 8844: comments 'no later than 16 August 2024'.
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The source page (article/5129, raw copy) says "The Validation Checklist for planning and other applications was adopted October 2024", which is what my workbook recorded (date basis "text: adopted October 2024"). So the October 2024 date is confirmed, not unverifiable.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The consultation closed 16 August 2024, so adoption in October 2024 fits. My helper read an old cached copy.
